author_role: nonimplementer of these product changes; independent synthetic tests only
observations: New no-yuan prefix alternatives require an explicit named RMB currency; a parse copy supplies the unit only after anchoring the original token and running continuation/currency/qualifier guards. Returned match text and code-point spans still derive from original bytes.

Traditional masked/uncertain words are folded only in detection copies; immediate source-edge matching retains punctuation as an event barrier. c600 restores the existing explicit-arithmetic priority before using MASKED.source, so x/×/* operands keep unsupported rather than uncertain.
Arithmetic adds only 係→系 to its existing finite detection map. Range adds 過→过 and 將→将 to its existing detection map; numeric parsing and source positions do not use folded coordinates.

The recurring payment schedule exemption requires 每月, a bounded 1–31 day, a finite payment verb and a terminal/clause boundary. It does not exempt slash rates, ordinary monthly rates, unknown days or another owner.

Source review extends only a schedule proven by the same shared helper over original anchored layout edges. The constructed quote is a temporary detection view; it does not persist new source text, quote, period, candidate positions or attribution.
The existing terminal source-review gate still reduces only non-null stored amounts; it never upgrades a stored unavailable amount. Confirmation and calculation authorization are unchanged.
limitations: This is a bounded synthetic and source-code review of five concrete findings, not proof of arbitrary Chinese grammar or legal semantic accuracy.
Actual CODE dual-runtime closure and the status regression test must be recorded separately after parent integration.
No HTTP, heavy/full/deep historical chain, model request, training, deployment, commit, push or human acceptance performed.
